privateConfiguration: Protected host environment files remain outside the artifact. Credentials, provider configuration, databases, uploads, caches, queues, and writable state must never be archived.
topology: Separate loopback-only Nuxt frontend on 4013 and operational backend on 3015, plus isolated compiled operations workers. Preserve the installed host paths, service identities, Nginx policy, IPv4/IPv6 listeners, external environment files, and writable-state directories. The protected cofoundry-native adapter owns the reviewed host-specific installation.
